env GO111MODULE=off

# Set up fresh GOCACHE.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

# Verify the standard library (specifically publicinternal/runtime/atomic) can be
# built with -gcflags when -n is given. See golang.org/issue/29346.
go build -n -gcflags=all='-l' std
stderr 'compile.* publicinternal/runtime/atomic .* -l'
